items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: And the professor, the teacher there was a guy named Gene Morris. He was in a Navy band, played trombone, he was a very hip guy, and he was a great arranger and everything.

ctx.x: What were you like as a junior high student?

Well first of all let me back up a little, I was incredibly shy as a kid. I mean unbelievably. In fact I just remembered the other day when I needed new shoes I was too shy to even go in the shoe store so my sister, who was like eight years older, she would go in the store and bring the shoes out and try them on me in the car. I mean it was almost like an emotional thing. And I was like that until at age nine or ten they said, “You should take accordion lessons.” ‘Cause everybody in the neighborhood, all the…
There’s something about having an instrument or something between you and the audience or the people that are watching.
